# Python built-in exception classes, one `child parent` pair per line.
# A class with two bases has two lines. Names with a leading underscore are left out.
# Runtime: CPython 3.14.5.
# `IOError` and `EnvironmentError` are `OSError` itself in this runtime, and are not listed.
# Produced by running this program with python3:
#   import builtins
#   def walk(c, out):
#       for s in c.__subclasses__():
#           if s.__module__ == "builtins" and not s.__name__.startswith("_"):
#               out.update((s.__name__, b.__name__) for b in s.__bases__)
#               walk(s, out)
#       return out
#   print("\n".join(f"{c} {p}" for c, p in sorted(walk(BaseException, set()))))
